headline: Microsoft confirms Windows updates cause black screen issues
summary: Microsoft has confirmed that recent Windows updates, including August 2026 preview updates and subsequent releases, are causing some users to experience desktop loading issues such as black screens. The bug affects virtual desktops, and some affected users may need to manually restart Explorer after signing in.
